purpose: is_active候选只读快照；仅供审计和条件回退，不代表已批准变更
query:
SELECT
  q.id,
  q.question_key,
  q.option_key,
  q.row_hash,
  q.is_active,
  q.cms_lifecycle,
  q.data_status,
  q.review_status
FROM question_option_mapping_v5_real q
WHERE q.cms_lifecycle='legacy_compat'
  AND q.is_active=1
  AND q.data_status='audited'
  AND q.review_status='audited'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM outcome_route_questions r
    WHERE r.question_key COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci = q.question_key COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
      AND r.enabled=1
      AND r.data_status='active'
      AND r.review_status='audited'
  )
ORDER BY q.id

safety.candidateRule: legacy_compat + is_active=1 + data_status=audited + review_status=audited + no enabled audited outcome route reference
